neet_che_u02_t00_1.working: Above threshold, higher intensity means more photons per second. So more photoelectrons are emitted per second. KE_max, threshold frequency and work function do not change.

neet_che_u02_t00_4.working: A is true because emission depends on frequency, not intensity. R is true above threshold. R does not explain A, since emission needs hν ≥ φ.

neet_che_u02_t00_5.working: I: 1/(500e-7 cm) = 2.0e4 cm^-1, so correct. II: KE = h(2ν0 − ν0) = hν0, which equals the work function, not twice it, so incorrect.
